name: Seema Sharma

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Seema Sharma’s Hindi poems in Kabita Live approach human dignity through both protest and compassion. “तुम्हारे बाप का घर नहीं है” questions the unequal burden of family honour placed on women. Its image of honour clinging to skin makes social surveillance feel inescapably physical, while its ending asks where a woman can truly belong.

“सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिन” speaks in a gentler register, imagining comfort for grieving people, a distressed child and suffering creatures. The wish to mend broken hearts grows into a prayer for everyone’s well-being. Together, the poems give anger at injustice and tenderness towards suffering a shared place.
